introduction: Gather the five different pieces of Aeirayne’s hematite star, with the queen’s court, sewers, dungeons, shrine and barracks as separate encounter leads.
orientation: Find Aeirayne at the Shrine of the Spider Queen when she is present. Ask hello, hi or help, then star, to hear her request. These words describe one request rather than separate completed quests.

The five star pieces look identical. Their sources are Queen Ze’rila, one white blugrul, Zantilanis, one whirlpool tentamort and the sludge dragon. Five copies of the same piece cannot replace one of each.

Carry all five different pieces loose and offer them together. Supplied exact pieces can also fit; the native request does not require a remembered conversation, personal kills or proof of original recovery.
Aeirayne gives the sleeves of zephyrs and the wand of the Spider Queen, then departs. One recorded return describes the exchange; actual reward delivery and departure remain separate consequences.
The basalt cave connects to the surrounding UnderDark. Protected doors, hidden passages and the dungeon’s downward routes make access and return separate challenges.

Hidden humming orbs in the dungeons can lead back to the Hall of Golems after discovery. The shrine leads to a blasted plain with tar and acid pools providing different return routes. Current visibility and admitted travel matter.

The court, inquisition, undead illithids, spiders, sewer creatures, guards and gladiator are wider encounter leads. Their battles and any future rescue, arena or temple stories remain separate from the accepted star return.

stories.title: Return the five pieces of Aeirayne’s star
stories.summary: Bring one of each distinct hematite star piece to Aeirayne for her sleeves, a wand and departure. The accepted return does not prove who defeated each source or originally recovered each piece.

steps.text: Carry the whirlpool tentamort star piece loose
steps.hint: The first stocked mentenozan tentamort in the festering whirlpool carries this exact piece. It looks like the other hematite shards, but another piece cannot substitute. A supplied exact piece can also fit; held, worn or nested pieces do not prepare this offering.

steps.text: Carry the sludge dragon star piece loose
steps.hint: The sludge dragon in the sewers carries this exact piece; its rune stone is a different item. It looks like the other hematite shards, but another piece cannot substitute. A supplied exact piece can also fit; held, worn or nested pieces do not prepare this offering.

steps.text: Carry the Zantilanis star piece loose
steps.hint: Zantilanis in the Pit of Lost Hope carries this exact piece. Search for the hidden orb when planning a return. It looks like the other hematite shards, but another piece cannot substitute. A supplied exact piece can also fit; held, worn or nested pieces do not prepare this offering.

steps.text: Carry the white blugrul star piece loose
steps.hint: The particular stocked white blugrul in the sewers carries this exact piece; other white blugruls need not carry it. It looks like the other hematite shards, but another piece cannot substitute. A supplied exact piece can also fit; held, worn or nested pieces do not prepare this offering.

steps.text: Carry the Queen Ze’rila star piece loose
steps.hint: Queen Ze’rila in the throne room carries this exact piece, rather than her followers. It looks like the other hematite shards, but another piece cannot substitute. A supplied exact piece can also fit; held, worn or nested pieces do not prepare this offering.

Offer all five different loose pieces together to Aeirayne when present. This is one accepted exchange for two rewards and departure; earlier dialogue, a personal kill, original recovery and an escort are not native prerequisites.
